column1: # owner-holds.tsv: owner holds, owner orders and dispatch rules that come from the owner or the PM, one row each.
# WRITTEN BY lane.local only (the owner's word goes in here, and nowhere else is an override read from).
# Seeded 2026-10-06 by lane.dispatchgate1006 from the records named in `source`; installed as pm/owner-holds.tsv.
# kind:     exclude (blocks the listed classes) | pending (owner ruling owed) | crash (open hang/crash, no fix)
#           | below_bar (perf miss: telemetry only) | order (an owner order: the ONLY override, cited by its id)
#           | window (a time window for a class) | device (a device rule) | build_floor (a build must contain a commit)
# match:    canonical or regional title ids, comma-separated; `genre:football`; `*` (every title); `device:<label>`
# classes:  dispatch classes the row blocks (exclude/pending/crash/below_bar) or permits (order); ALL = every class
# release:  what lifts it. "issues close" = lifted automatically when every number in `issues` is closed on the forge.
#           Anything else is lifted only when lane.local writes the date and the owner's words into `released`.
# value:    window: last_start=HH:MM stop=HH:MM date=YYYY-MM-DD (PT) | device: max_s=N | build_floor: <commit>
